items.summary_en: In a small village in Quebec, Canada, people still love cowboy culture. They wear western clothes, ride horses, and hold rodeo events. The French-speaking community keeps this way of life alive.

items.title_en: Cowboy Culture Thrives in a Small Quebec Village

items.raw_excerpt: When Gavin Maycroft arrived in Stockholm aged 28 to join his Swedish girlfriend, he’d mainly been a waiter. But he soon blagged his way into DJing and music events, and 20 years later is one of the main bookers for the Stockholm Jazz Festival.
items.summary_en: Gavin Maycroft moved to Stockholm at 28 to be with his girlfriend. He started as a waiter but soon began DJing and booking events. Now he helps run the Stockholm Jazz Festival.
items.summary_ko: 28세에 여자친구를 따라 스톡홀름으로 이주했다. 웨이터로 일하다가 DJ와 행사 기획을 시작해 지금은 스톡홀름 재즈페스티벌 기획에 참여하고 있다.
items.title_en: From waiter to jazz festival booker in Stockholm
items.title_ko: 웨이터에서 스톡홀름 재즈페스티벌 기획자가 되기까지
items.title_original: My Swedish Career: 'By moving here I had more chance of doing what I dreamed of'

items.raw_excerpt: After a local hunter reported a 'big cat sighting' near Munich, local police have deployed drones, dogs and a helicopter to comb the surrounding region.
items.summary_en: A local hunter reported seeing a big cat near Munich. Police used drones, dogs, and a helicopter to search the area. The animal was said to be a puma.
items.summary_ko: 한 지역 사냥꾼이 뮌헨 근처에서 큰 고양잇과 동물을 보았다고 신고했습니다. 경찰은 드론과 개, 헬리콥터를 동원해 주변 지역을 수색했습니다. 목격된 동물은 퓨마로 알려졌습니다.
items.title_en: Police search for puma near Munich airport
items.title_ko: 뮌헨 공항 근처에서 퓨마 목격, 경찰 수색
items.title_original: Police search for puma near Munich airport

items.raw_excerpt: Remember the star of a French supermarket's Christmas advert last year - a misunderstood wolf who gave up meat, learned to cook and made friends thanks to his vegetarian recipes? Well, he's back, as a toy.
items.summary_en: A French supermarket's Christmas advert featured a wolf who gave up meat and learned to cook. The beloved character became famous last year. Now he is back as a toy that people can buy.
items.summary_ko: 프랑스 한 슈퍼마켓의 크리스마스 광고에 고기를 그만두고 요리를 배운 늑대가 등장했어요. 이 캐릭터는 지난해 큰 인기를 끌었죠. 이제 그 늑대가 장난감으로 다시 돌아왔어요.
items.title_en: French viral vegetarian wolf is finally appearing in toy form
items.title_ko: 프랑스에서 화제 된 채식 늑대, 장난감으로 나온다
items.title_original: French viral vegetarian wolf is finally appearing in toy form

items.raw_excerpt: When you move yourself, your family, and belongings from the United States to Switzerland, you may be tempted to bring your vehicle as well. But there are good reasons to leave it behind.
items.summary_en: People moving from the United States to Switzerland often want to bring their car. But this can cause big problems that are not worth it. It is better to leave the car behind.
items.summary_ko: 미국에서 스위스로 이사하는 사람들은 차도 함께 가져오고 싶어 합니다. 하지만 큰 문제가 생길 수 있어 그만한 가치가 없습니다. 차는 두고 오는 편이 낫습니다.
items.title_en: Why you should not bring your US car to Switzerland
items.title_ko: 미국 차를 스위스로 가져오지 않는 게 좋은 이유
items.title_original: 'A total nightmare': Why you shouldn't bring your US car to Switzerland

items.raw_excerpt: A charity that runs a museum in Oshawa has received nearly $3,000 in city fines for allowing "nuisance activity" on its property. It says it needs help, not penalties, to keep the museum safe from vandalism, trespassing and damage.
items.summary_en: A charity museum in Oshawa, Ontario has been fined almost $3,000 by the city. The fines are for letting homeless people camp on its property. The charity says it needs help, not penalties, to keep the museum safe from damage.
items.summary_ko: 캐나다 온타리오주 오샤와의 한 자선 박물관이 시에서 벌금 3천 달러 가까이를 부과받았다. 부지에 노숙자들이 텐트를 치도록 내버려 두었다는 이유다. 이 단체는 박물관을 훼손과 무단 침입으로부터 지키려면 벌금이 아니라 도움이 필요하다고 말한다.
items.title_en: Ontario museum fined nearly $3,000 over homeless camps on its land
items.title_ko: 온타리오 박물관, 부지 내 노숙자 텐트 때문에 벌금 3천 달러 가까이 부과
items.title_original: Ontario museum facing nearly $3K in city fines over homeless encampments on property

items.summary_en: Beavers in Poland chewed down a sign that warned people about beavers. Park workers had put up the sign, but the animals took it apart. It is a funny reminder of how busy beavers can be.
items.summary_ko: 폴란드에서 비버들이 비버를 조심하라는 안내 표지판을 갉아 부쉈다. 공원 측이 세운 표지판이었지만 비버들은 이를 그대로 망가뜨렸다. 비버가 얼마나 부지런한지 보여 주는 웃픈 사례다.

items.raw_excerpt: A total of 228 foreign guests will take part in 2026 Republic of China (Taiwan) National Day celebrations, including King Mswati III of Taiwan's sole African ally Eswatini and Indiana Lieutenant Governor Micah Beckwith, according to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MOFA) on Thursday.
items.summary_en: Taiwan's foreign ministry said 228 foreign guests will attend the 2026 National Day celebrations. They include King Mswati III of Eswatini, Taiwan's only African ally, and Indiana Lieutenant Governor Micah Beckwith.
items.summary_ko: 대만 외교부가 2026년 국경일 행사에 외국인 하객 228명이 참석한다고 밝혔다. 이들 가운데는 대만의 유일한 아프리카 우방국인 에스와티니의 음스와티 3세 국왕과 미국 인디애나주 부지사 마이카 베크위스도 포함됐다.
items.title_en: Taiwan says 228 foreign guests will join its National Day events

items.summary_en: Oslo Central Station will be closed all day Saturday. The ongoing rail strike is also affecting many train services across Eastern Norway.

items.raw_excerpt: Look, we're not saying that everyone has to move to France - but if you want to make the move and haven't, then we're keen to hear about the reasons that are preventing you, and whether they are temporary or permanent.
items.summary_en: A news site asks readers who dream of moving to France why they have not done it yet. It wants to know if the reasons are temporary or permanent. The topic is light and personal, not serious news.

items.raw_excerpt: Brits who lived in Austria before the end of the Brexit transition period were able to keep their residency rights, but many people have faced hurdles. We spoke with rights' groups and the Interior Ministry to look at what's happening in Austria.
items.summary_en: British people who lived in Austria before Brexit can still stay. But many of them now face problems with their residence permits. Rights groups and the Interior Ministry are looking at the issue.

items.title_en: Brits in Austria Face Problems With Brexit Residence Permits
items.title_ko: 오스트리아에 사는 영국인들, 거주 허가 문제로 어려움

items.raw_excerpt: Nestled deep within the valleys of central Portugal near Proença-a-Nova, the Praia Fluvial do Pego das Cancelas is a true river oasis where wild nature meets absolute relaxation.
items.summary_en: Deep in the valleys of central Portugal lies a quiet river beach called Pego das Cancelas. It sits near the town of Proenca-a-Nova. Here wild nature meets calm and total relaxation.

items.raw_excerpt: Una captura aérea registrada por un dron este jueves expone el retroceso hídrico en la península de Tihany, en la orilla norte del lago Balatón (Hungría), donde su lago interior de 30 hectáreas quedó reducido a un lecho fangoso y prácticamente seco, evidenciando un crítico episodio de secado en este enclave natural europeo.
items.summary_en: A drone filmed the inner lake on the Tihany peninsula in Hungary. This 30-hectare lake sits on the north shore of Lake Balaton. It has shrunk to a muddy, almost dry bed.
items.summary_ko: 드론이 헝가리 티하니 반도의 호수를 촬영했습니다. 발라톤 호수 북쪽 기슭에 있는 30헥타르짜리 이 호수는 진흙 바닥만 남기고 거의 말라버렸습니다. 유럽의 이 자연 명소가 심각한 가뭄을 겪고 있음을 보여 줍니다.
items.title_en: Drone shows dried-up inner lake on Hungary's Tihany peninsula
items.title_ko: 드론이 담은 헝가리 티하니 반도의 말라버린 호수
items.title_original: Sequía en Hungría: Imágenes muestran lago en Tihany al borde de la desaparición

items.raw_excerpt: Lathrop is one of 234 Red Cross volunteers in Maine who logged more than 20,000 hours helping others in 2025.
items.summary_en: Lathrop is one of 234 Red Cross volunteers in Maine. Together they logged more than 20,000 hours helping people in 2025. She says she feels she has to do this when disaster strikes.
items.summary_ko: 래스럽 씨는 메인주 적십자 자원봉사자 234명 중 한 명이다. 이들은 2025년에 모두 2만 시간 넘게 어려운 이웃을 도왔다. 그녀는 재난이 닥치면 자신이 꼭 해야 한다는 마음이 든다고 말한다.
items.title_en: Maine Red Cross volunteer gives her time to help others
items.title_ko: 메인주 적십자 자원봉사자, 이웃 돕기에 삶을 바친다
items.title_original: Maine Red Cross volunteer dedicates life to others in need - Spectrum News

items.raw_excerpt: Thrusting himself into the heart of the protests by high school students that have shaken France, the hard-left mayor of a Paris suburb has become an icon for protesters with his full-throated support of their movement and physical presence on the streets.
items.summary_en: A mayor from a Paris suburb strongly supports high school student protests. He joins the students in the streets. Many people now see him as an icon of the movement.

items.raw_excerpt: Kerala Lalithakala Akademi unveils plans to elevate galleries, host art camps, launch international Art Exchange, and secure new funding.
items.summary_en: A local art academy in Kerala wants to grow its reach. It plans to improve its galleries, run art camps, and start an international art exchange. The group also hopes to find new funding.
